summary: The article provides a reliable overview of the role of Mutual Fund Distributors in India, with most claims aligning with information from regulatory bodies like SEBI and AMFI.

claims.claim: MFDs are increasingly crucial for offering comprehensive investor guidance, moving beyond mere scheme selection.
claims.note: SEBI's Whole-Time Member, Amarjeet Singh, highlighted the evolving role of MFDs beyond scheme selection to comprehensive investor guidance.

claims.claim: SEBI emphasises their significant role in helping investors maintain discipline and navigate market volatility effectively.
claims.note: SEBI's Whole-Time Member, Amarjeet Singh, referred to MFDs as a "behavioural anchor, particularly during periods of market volatility," helping investors avoid impulsive decisions.

claims.claim: MFDs earn commissions from the Asset Management Companies (AMCs) whose funds they distribute, making them product-sellers. RIAs, on the other hand, charge a fee directly from their clients for their advice and cannot earn commissions from AMCs, ensuring their advice is conflict-free.
claims.note: SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013, state that RIAs charge fees directly from clients and cannot receive commissions from product manufacturers, while MFDs operate on a commission-based model from AMCs.

claims.claim: MFDs typically do not charge a direct fee to the investor. Their remuneration comes in the form of commissions paid by the Asset Management Companies (AMCs) from the expense ratio of the mutual fund schemes.
claims.note: MFDs earn trail commissions from AMCs, which are embedded in the expense ratio of regular mutual fund plans, meaning investors do not pay a direct fee.

claims.claim: You can verify the legitimacy of a Mutual Fund Distributor by checking their ARN (AMFI Registration Number) on the official website of AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India).
claims.note: AMFI issues a unique AMFI Registration Number (ARN) to certified mutual fund distributors, which can be verified on the AMFI India website.

article_title: Mutual Fund Distributors: Your Behavioural Anchor in Investing
